Coordinated inauthentic social accounts.provides: narrative amplification, no access to any official system

Hack and leak of campaign material.provides: authentic embarrassing material, one-time effect, needs media uptake

Physical tampering with voting machines.requires: physical access to devices in custody
Physical tampering with voting machines.provides: direct effect on counts, extremely constrained access, forensic evidence

Change the recorded vote count.requires: access to tabulation or ballots themselves
Change the recorded vote count.provides: direct alteration of the result, detectable by audit

Suppress turnout in specific areas.provides: indirect effect on the result, plausible deniability

Discredit the result regardless of outco.requires: only visible doubt, not actual alteration
Discredit the result regardless of outco.provides: success even when nothing is changed, no need for system access

Electoral commission audit.requires: a paper trail or auditable record
Electoral commission audit.provides: detection of count and registration anomalies, blind to online activity

Platform trust and safety team.requires: the activity occurring on their service
Platform trust and safety team.provides: detection of inauthentic accounts, no visibility of intrusions

Intelligence service attribution.provides: identification of a foreign hand, slow, often unpublishable

Journalist investigation.requires: a source or a public trail
Journalist investigation.provides: public exposure of anything documented, unpredictable timing

Months before polling.provides: time for infrastructure intrusion and narrative building, time for defenders to respond

Final week.provides: no time for correction, maximum impact per unit effort

After polls close.provides: no effect on votes, only on acceptance of the result

_v1_notes.ACTOR|VECTOR: database intrusion is N for a domestic partisan group and a troll farm - neither has intrusion capability. Physical tampering is Y only for a domestic group with local access and N for a foreign service, a troll farm and a lone hacker. Hack and leak is N for a troll farm.
_v1_notes.ACTOR|OBJECTIVE: changing the recorded count is N for everyone except a foreign service - it needs system access at tabulation, which the others lack.
_v1_notes.ACTOR|DETECTION OWNER: intelligence attribution is N for domestic actors and a lone hacker - it exists to identify foreign hands. A troll farm is N for electoral commission audit, having touched no electoral system.
_v1_notes.ACTOR|TIMING: a lone hacker is N after polls close - there is no target left that matches the capability.
_v1_notes.VECTOR|OBJECTIVE: inauthentic accounts are N for changing the count. Hack and leak is N for changing the count and N for turnout suppression - it is a narrative weapon. Physical tampering is N for turnout suppression, acting on ballots not on people.
_v1_notes.VECTOR|DETECTION OWNER: database intrusion and machine tampering are both N for platform teams. Inauthentic accounts are N for electoral audit and N for intelligence attribution as posed. Hack and leak is N for audit and N for platforms.
_v1_notes.VECTOR|TIMING: database intrusion is N after polls close. Physical tampering is N months before (machines not yet in position) and N after polls close.
_v1_notes.OBJECTIVE|DETECTION OWNER: changing the count is N for platform teams. Suppression, discrediting and favouring a candidate are all N for electoral audit, which sees counts, not persuasion.
_v1_notes.OBJECTIVE|TIMING: changing the count, suppressing turnout and favouring a candidate are all N after polls close. Only discrediting the result survives that boundary.
